title: Classify: tabular machine learning
description: Use the merged Classify screen with downloadable measured cells, explicit metadata labels, a bounded random forest, real console output and saved predictions.
objectives: Choose the tabular family and load the measured example through the native data chooser.
Define plate-column classes and distinguish the requested split from actual held-out wells.
Inspect plots, missing scores and model outputs without treating demonstration accuracy as biological validation.
prerequisite: Use Load test data in Classify and choose Load, not Stream. The example has 2,341 cell/crop identities across four wells. The recorded ML join retains 2,153 objects and excludes 188 lacking nucleus rows. Classes are columnID=c1 (zero) and c2 (one), not independently verified phenotypes. The native run uses random_forest, channel_of_interest=1, n_estimators=16, n_jobs=2, n_repeats=1, top_features=10, batch_correction=none, prune_features=False, cross_validation=False and plot=True. Match test_size=0.1 to the merged test_split=0.1: the current normalization otherwise discards the ML-specific request; this defect is reported, not hidden. Actual holdout: two of four wells, 1,035 of 2,153 objects, with no database well overlap. Feature filtering precedes splitting and permutation importance uses training data; these are not independently validated feature discoveries. Nine saved metric values and all 2,153 database predictions were independently checked. Held-out accuracy is 0.6202898551 versus majority-class accuracy 0.5632850242. API: spacr.classify.classify dispatches to spacr.ml.generate_ml_scores; outputs are under results/random_forest/channel_1. Database predictions holds the binary class and ml_pred the class-one probability. Only three real GUI figures are claimed; no SHAP, calibrated probability, causal effect or biological validation claim. No AI request was submitted.

scenes.narration: Open Classify from Home and choose Tabular Machine Learning as the classifier family. This is the merged Classify screen, not a separate ML application. It learns from saved per-object measurements. Computer-vision settings can remain visible but greyed out because they belong to the other family.

Click Load test data and choose Load. This downloads the measured example and prepares its paths; Stream is a different route. For your own project, complete Measure first and select its project folder. Do not assume an arbitrary image folder already contains the required measurement database.

Use the metadata basis and define two Classes from column I D: c1 and c2. Here those are plate-column labels used to teach the workflow, not independently verified healthy and affected cells. Annotation-based training instead needs genuine labels from Annotate. Never turn missing annotations into invented ground truth.

Channel of interest selects the measurement features. We use channel one without assigning it an unverified biological meaning. Check your acquisition and measurement settings before choosing a channel in your own data. Selecting a feature channel here does not re-segment images or measure them again.

Choose Random Forest and sixteen estimators for this small demonstration, with two worker jobs. This is not an optimized model recommendation. We leave supervised feature pruning and cross-validation off. Cross-validation being off does not remove the separate held-out test split used by this run.

Set test size to one tenth and keep grouping by well. A requested fraction is not an exact object count: this four-well example holds out two whole wells, about forty-eight percent of its retained objects. Both classes appear on each side, and no actual well appears in both training and test.

Turn Plot on, clear the search and press Run. The console records the resolved settings, filtering, split and model report. Keep that record with the results. A finished badge does not establish that your labels, validation design or biological interpretation were appropriate.

This run scores two thousand one hundred fifty-three objects. One hundred eighty-eight lack matching nucleus data and remain unscored, not negative. The saved test accuracy is about sixty-two percent, versus fifty-six percent for the majority class. Four wells on one plate do not establish generalization to a new experiment.

Three figures are available: permutation importance, tree feature importance and this plate heatmap. With Predictions and mean grouping, the heatmap averages binary predicted classes, not their probabilities. Importance is not causality; the permutation calculation uses training data. Inspect the saved tables before drawing conclusions from a colourful plot.

The AI toggle enables provider-assisted questions about the workflow. This is an unsent draft, not a generated answer. Keep results with their settings and verify any advice. Nested tools have their own input requirements: the Explain tutorial uses computer-vision scores, not these ML outputs. AI does not replace checking labels and split identities.
